prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animation sprite sheet for an OBS mascot.
Input image: exact character identity AND costume reference. Preserve this same outfit, hat, hair, face proportions, footwear and colors in every visible pose.
Create one polished 4 by 4 sprite sheet, EXACTLY 16 evenly spaced full-body poses in reading order. Each pose centered in its own equally sized cell, fixed character scale and baseline, generous EMPTY transparent gutter around every cell (at least 12% of cell dimensions). No text, no labels, no grid, no background or ground shadow. Cute clean anime illustration matching reference.
Action is a magical costume-change DEPARTURE sequence: 01 relaxed standing empty hands, 02 slight knee bend hands rise, 03 elbows bend hands near chest, 04 palms together focused smile, 05 eyes shut gathering tiny lemon-gold light, 06 wrists crossed over chest, 07 arms open forming a luminous ribbon around waist, 08 body quarter turn with lively hair swing, 09 side turn arms extended light ribbon circles, 10 three-quarter back twirl ribbon spirals upward, 11 turning back to front arms up and luminous ribbons surround body, 12 excited magical star pose with light covering shoes and clothes, 13 warm gold star-shaped light conceals most body but face remains visible, 14 soft white-gold glow fully conceals character and costume into a compact vertical magical cocoon, 15 isolated bright lemon-gold cocoon with small four-point stars, 16 same fully opaque WHITE-GOLD MAGIC COCOON core, golden outline and a few short sparkle rays, all character details entirely hidden. The cocoon stays roughly the same dimensions as the standing character, with transparent background around it. No disconnected floating instructional arrows. Every cell must contain the complete pose/effect, nothing may touch cell edges. Meaningfully distinct changing limb poses in first 12 cells, not duplicate stills. Transformation is clothed and family-friendly.
